_comment: Feature flags that exist only in ClickHouse's OTel demo FORK, not the stock chart's flag catalog. scripts/deploy-otel.sh merges these into the flag catalog so they become selectable via SCENARIOS. A flag here only DOES something if the service that reads it is also the fork build (e.g. paymentCacheLeak needs the fork payment image — deploy-otel.sh handles that image swap when the flag is selected).

paymentCacheLeak.description: Payment service Visa validation cache leak (fills to CACHE_SIZE, then 'Visa cache full: cannot add new item.'). Requires the ClickHouse-fork payment + load-generator images, which deploy-otel.sh builds and loads automatically when this flag is selected.
